description: This file defines extension methods for configuring grain extensions in an Orleans silo environment. It specifically provides a method to register grain extensions via dependency injection.

classes.name: HostingGrainExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring grain extensions on an Orleans silo.

methods.name: AddGrainExtension
methods.description: Registers a grain extension implementation for a specified interface in the silo's dependency injection container.
